newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Yukong postpones CDU maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Yukong postpones CDU maintenance.

text.p: Yukong Ltd, South Korea's largest oil refiner, said on Monday it had delayed the scheduled maintenance shutdown of its 265,000 barrels-per-day (BPD) crude distillation unit (CDU) to October 15.
It had previously planned to close the unit on Monday for four weeks.
Company officials said the Yukong's biggest CDU would resume operation on November 14.
"We have decided to postpone the maintenance because our new CDU's commercial operation has been delayed," a Yukong official said.

Full production of its new 200,000 bpd CDU, which was expected by Tuesday, would be delayed until Sunday due to maintenance work on several cracks on the topper's pipeline welding joints, the company said earlier.
Yukong has a refining capability of 610,000 bpd and is scheduled to expand production to 810,000 bpd with the new CDU.
